senses.definition: A flower, especially one indicating that a fruit tree is fruiting; (collectively) a mass of such flowers.
examples: The blossom has come early this year.

[…] And his rod whom I choſe / ſhall bloſſome: So I wyll make ceaſe from me the grudgynges of the childern of Iſrael which they grudge agenſt you.
